tagline: Your plan, logged set by set
brief: An AI-powered workout app: create and manage a training plan from any AI agent, then log it set by set in the gym. It should feel like a physio's chart — precise, quiet and trustworthy — not like a loud gym brand.
criteria: Success: reads as an S at 16 px, owns the Slate & Teal palette, avoids dumbbells/flames/AI sparkles, and echoes the app's own progress language.

concepts.name: Progress S
concepts.idea: One continuous S; the last stretch breaks off in teal — the set you're on now.
rationale: Same language as the app: solid = done, teal = in progress (week bar, set checks)
Built from one radius and one stroke weight, like a logbook rule
Holds at 16 px thanks to a dedicated small-size cut

recommendation: Progress S — slate track, teal current set. Use the dark tile as the app icon.
next_steps: Drop the icon set into sets-app and gym-app
Swap the old gold S launcher icon
Run a trademark search before launch
